title: MxAgile Process State
description: Per-wave runtime lifecycle state. File: .concord/scratch/process-state.yaml (gitignored). CANONICAL UPDATE RULE: always write the COMPLETE wave block — never append individual keys into an existing block. Appending creates duplicate YAML keys. See .mxagile/policies/lifecycle-resync.md.

waves.description: Keyed by wave ID (e.g. W01, W02). Each wave block must be written atomically.

wave.description: State for one wave. phase MUST appear exactly once — write the full block, never append.

phase.description: Current lifecycle phase. Defined in .mxagile/lifecycle.yaml. One occurrence per wave block.

paused_at.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) when the wave was paused

completed_scripts.description: MDL scripts executed and done in this wave

next_script.description: Next MDL script to execute on resume (supplementary — checklist is authoritative)

resume_from.description: Supplementary free-text hint. Structured checklist state (done/pending/failed) is authoritative for resume position.

result.description: not_recorded is only valid before the gate has been run for this wave.

evidence.description: Key-value evidence supporting the gate result. Any structure allowed.
